# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release receives security fixes.

| Version      | Supported |
| ------------ | --------- |
| 1.0.0-alpha  | Yes       |
| earlier      | No        |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue. Email <hakim@ghoula.net> with a description and, where possible, a minimal reproduction.

Reports are acknowledged within 5 business days. Confirmed vulnerabilities are resolved before the next release.
